title: Langevin for Nonconvex Optimization: Exact, Inexact and Zeroth-Order
summary: We study Langevin-based methods for non-convex optimization under smoothness and dissipativity assumptions, focusing on non-asymptotic expected excess-risk bounds rather than sampling guarantees for the full target distribution. A main methodological message is that relative-entropy sampling guarantees can be converted directly into expected objective-value guarantees, without passing through Wasserstein distance.
